findings.title: Row items are off by a few pixels
findings.evidence: span#lovable-badge-text “Edit with” and span#lovable-badge-logo sit in the same row but their top edges differ by 2px (870 vs 868). 1px is sub-pixel noise; 2–3px is a mistake, not a decision.
findings.fix: Align them on the same axis: use align-items on the parent, or give both the same margin-top. If the offset is intentional, make it ≥ 8px so it reads as deliberate.

findings.title: Nested cards (×2)
findings.fix: Cards inside cards create visual noise and excessive depth. Flatten the hierarchy — use spacing, typography, and dividers instead of nesting containers.

findings.title: Inter for 95% of the text
findings.evidence: Primary family is Inter, one of the fonts generated UIs default to. Fonts seen: Manrope, Inter, system-ui.
findings.fix: Not wrong on its own. If everything else is default too, this is the cheapest thing to change: pick one typeface with a point of view for headings and keep the workhorse for body.
findings.citation: Impeccable overused-font; HN thread on vibe-coded tells (Inter everywhere)

findings.title: 5 untouched shadcn/ui cards
findings.evidence: Class strings like “rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow” are the component library's defaults, unmodified. Fine as scaffolding; as the final look it's tell #1.
findings.fix: Change the tokens (radius, border colour, shadow) once in your theme so the components stop looking like the docs page.

findings.title: Head is missing: canonical
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD structured data either, so AI search engines have nothing to cite. One h1, good.
findings.fix: Ten minutes of <head> work: title under 60 chars, canonical URL, lang attribute, favicon, and an Organization or WebSite JSON-LD block.

findings.title: 7 tap targets under 32px on a phone
findings.evidence: e.g. button.inline-flex.items-center “+ Gas Furnace Installation” 300×16px; button.inline-flex.items-center “+ Heat Pump Installation” 290×16px; button.inline-flex.items-center “+ Ductwork” 201×16px. Apple's floor is 44pt, WCAG's 24px with space around it.
findings.fix: Give links and buttons padding so the hit area is at least 44×44px on touch screens, or at least 24px with space around it.
findings.citation: WCAG 2.5.8 target size (24px, with spacing and inline exceptions); Apple HIG 44pt
